answer_1.quote: Our goal is to develop models and datasets to map multi-step instructions into automatically executable actions given the screen information.

answer_2.quote: We use two metrics that measure how a predicted tuple sequence matches the ground-truth sequence. • Complete Match: The score is 1 if two sequences have the same length and have the identical tuple [r j , ôj , ûj ] at each step, otherwise 0. • Partial Match: The number of steps of the predicted sequence that match the ground-truth sequence divided by the length of the groundtruth sequence (ranging between 0 and 1).
